notes: Controller: state machine (pre -> descend -> grasp -> lift -> move -> lower -> release -> retreat, with retries) driving the right arm via damped-least-squares IK on robot.model (grasp_site position + orientation, palm facing down, fingers horizontal at a chosen yaw psi). A Cartesian "carrot" moves the IK target in a straight line at ~0.35 m/s (slowed when the arm lags), and the per-step IK joint change is capped (0.07 rad) so the commanded joints never saturate the rate limiter and stay on one IK branch. Hand yaw candidates are the cube yaw + k*90deg; the grasp yaw is chosen by evaluating IK error and self/table/other-block collisions (mj_collision on the kin copy) at both the grasp pose and the place pose, with a position-dependent preference (fingers pointing more to the left near the torso). During transport a place yaw (grasp yaw + k*45deg) is re-selected for feasibility at the destination. Placement compensates the measured in-hand offset of the held cube; the cube is released 1.2 cm above the destination cube. Failed grasps/lifts, stalls, and failed stacks trigger retries (new yaw). Known weaknesses: the final version (place-yaw re-selection, release/retreat using place_R) was not re-tested after the last edits; previous version was 17/20 on practice seeds, failures being unreachable hand yaw at destinations near the torso (y > -0.17), which the last edits target. Transit height is only 12 cm above the table due to limited reach near the body; destination cubes can occasionally be nudged during lowering.
